item.title: Tragic Loss: Elephant Calf Dies from Ingesting Bomb
item.description: Tragic Loss: Elephant Calf Dies from Ingesting Bomb A young female elephant calf tragically died after consuming a country-made bomb at the Sathyamangalam Tiger Reserve, officials reported.The elephant, found dead by forest personnel patrols, displayed severe injuries around its trunk and mouth. An autopsy by a forest veterinarian confirmed the cause was a bomb ingestion.Authorities suspect the device was placed by a local farmer or poacher to deter elephants from encroaching on cultivated areas

item.title: French Farmers Rally with Tractors: EU-Mercosur Deal Sparks Protests
item.description: French Farmers Rally with Tractors: EU-Mercosur Deal Sparks Protests French farmers drove into the heart of Paris on Tuesday, marking their second tractor protest in a week against a contentious EU-Mercosur trade agreement.
